name: Company Profile
tagline: Builds a corporate profile: business model, segments, competitors and risks.
description: Takes a company name or a free-text description of a business and researches its corporate profile: how it makes money, which segments and geographies it operates in, who its direct competitors are and which structural risks shape its outlook, returning a short profile with the sources it consulted.
